We’re hiring AI Software Product Developer who are strong developers with a
clear product and commercial mindset.
This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and revenue, building
and scaling B2B sales and marketing platforms that directly drive growth.

JD example

9


Expect an AI-first environment, with a mix of hands-on development and
stakeholder collaboration across sales, marketing, and RevOps.
What you’ll be doing:
Building and improving B2B sales & revenue platforms
Supporting customer acquisition, marketing funnels, and GTM initiatives
Working with sales tooling and data enrichment platforms
Translating business needs into product-driven engineering solutions
What we’re looking for:
Strong software engineering background with product exposure
Experience in product-led or SaaS environments
Someone who has experience building automations with AI, commercially
or in personal projects
Exposure to CRM/CSM, sales, or revenue-focused systems
Commercial mindset — you care about building things that drive revenue
Comfortable working closely with non-technical stakeholders
Tech & environment:
AI-first development workflows
Modern GTM and sales tooling ecosystem
